propositions: Detached pytest runs report errors that do not reproduce in foreground runs, caused not by detachment itself but by concurrent external mutations (file creation, git operations, process reaping) that foreground runs structurally prevent
The _no_repo_root_leaks guard misattributes concurrent external top-level mutations to innocent tests and deletes those files, making detached suites silently destroy concurrent agent artifacts
Browser e2e test failures on signal-killed child processes report empty stderr without consulting proc.returncode, making a reaped child indistinguishable from a real product regression
The mechanism is deterministically reproducible: a concurrent external touch or kill during a detached suite reproduces the reported error signature with 100% fidelity

Guards must report both possibilities (test-caused vs concurrent-external) rather than asserting test fault, and child-process diagnostics must include returncode to distinguish signal kills from genuine failures
